name: Pastor Philip Olubakin
bio: Founder and Lead Pastor of Supernatural Life Church, a growing ministry committed to helping believers live beyond the ordinary through the power of God's Word and the Holy Spirit. Trained as a lawyer before answering God's call to ministry, he is also an author, songwriter and conference speaker. Through initiatives such as Wind of the Spirit and 28 Days with the Holy Spirit, he has inspired many believers to cultivate deeper intimacy with God and embrace the realities of supernatural living.
emphasis: The ministry of the Holy Spirit
atIgc: A unique grace for helping believers understand and practically experience the life of the Spirit.

name: Pastor Ayo Ajani
role: Global Senior Pastor, Petra Christian Centre · Founder, Ayo Ajani Ministries International (TribePetra World Inc.)
bio: A renowned teacher, pastor and communicator whose ministry has impacted millions of lives across multiple nations. With over two decades in ministry, he is known for communicating profound biblical truths with simplicity, practicality and power. He leads Petra Christian Centre, with expressions across Nigeria, Ghana and the United Kingdom, and convenes gatherings such as Rain Conference, Kindle and The Festival Convention. He is also an author and ministry mentor.
atIgc: A strong apostolic and teaching grace that equips believers to understand and experience the supernatural as a daily reality.

name: Pastor O. Jacob
bio: Pastor Jacob Ekundayo Ogundipe, popularly known as Pastor O. Jacob, is a seasoned teacher of God's Word, revival advocate, author and church leader. As Pastor-in-Charge of RCCG FCT Province 3, he provides spiritual oversight and leadership to churches across the province. His ministry is marked by a passion for prayer, sound doctrine, discipleship, and raising believers grounded in Scripture and committed to Kingdom service.
atIgc: Spiritual depth, wisdom, and a call to disciplined Christian living that strengthens believers for long-term Kingdom impact.

name: Apostle Emmanuel Effa Isaac
bio: Founder and President of Anagkazo Mission International, an apostolic movement committed to raising spiritually mature believers equipped to influence territories, communities and nations. His ministry emphasizes discipleship, spiritual formation, Kingdom responsibility, and the raising of watchmen, saviours and deliverers. Through conferences, mentorship platforms and teaching ministries, he challenges believers toward consecration, purpose and transformational impact.
atIgc: An apostolic burden for raising believers who will become effective Kingdom ambassadors in their generation.

name: Apostle Jonathan Shekwonya
role: President, Family Worship Experience International (FWEI Nations)
bio: Founder and President of FWEI Nations. His ministry is devoted to raising believers through worship, prayer, discipleship and intimacy with God. Beginning ministry in his early twenties, he has become a respected revival voice known for stirring hunger for God and cultivating spiritual maturity in believers. He is a graduate of Nasarawa State University and has a rich heritage of ministry service.
atIgc: A revival dimension that inspires consecration, deeper devotion and passionate pursuit of God's presence.

name: Minister David Dam
bio: A respected gospel music minister, worship leader, songwriter and psalmist. Associate Music Director of Eternity Network International (Koinonia Global), widely known for songs such as Ebenezer, Father of Mercy, Jesus Revealed and Rest on Me. Convener of Altar of Worship LIVE, a platform dedicated to intimate and prophetic worship.
atIgc: A worship grace that creates room for encounters with God, healing, surrender and spiritual renewal.

name: Minister Deborah BillyBen
bio: A Nigerian gospel music minister, songwriter and worship leader known for powerful worship expressions and revival-centred ministry. Through songs such as Mount Carmel, Kabod, Exalted and Sound The Alarm (Anazao), she calls believers into deeper fellowship with God. Convener of the Mount Carmel Experience, a worship gathering dedicated to prayer, revival and encounters with God.
atIgc: A powerful atmosphere of worship, hunger for God and spiritual awakening that draws believers into deeper encounters with Christ.

name: Pastor Deji Hassan
role: Gospel Music Minister & Worship Leader, “The Praise Ambassador”
bio: An ordained RCCG minister, active in gospel music ministry since 2008, committed to using worship and praise to encourage believers and draw people closer to God. He is also an engineer, former banker and fashion consultant, and has ministered alongside Nathaniel Bassey, Prospa Ochimana, Chioma Jesus and other notable gospel ministers. His ministry is characterized by joyful praise, faith-filled worship, and a passion for creating environments where people can celebrate God's goodness.
atIgc: A dynamic praise dimension that inspires faith, joy, celebration and heartfelt worship.
